title: Campaign Atlas · Europe and its approaches · continuous map, level 0
era: Physical geography as of about 1800, for every starting date from 1798 to 1815
art_direction: Campaign Atlas: the theatre of war as one continuous hand-coloured engraving. Storm-toned sea with coast lining and ruled swell; land in gouache washes by climate belt; relief shaded from the upper left and hachured; forests as massed tree marks; rivers and lakes in ink and pale water. No hexes, no frontiers, no towns and no lettering are painted in: the hex grid, territory washes, cities and names are overlays the game draws. Full statement in design/ART-DECISIONS.md and design/art/maps.md.
light_direction: Upper left (north-west): slopes facing south-east fall into shadow and carry the heavier hachures; coasts facing away from the light are drawn heavier.
